limitations: Only tsField bytes0–2879 are acquired and hashed. Whole FITS SHA256 is unknown; extension rows, native field clocks, calibration coefficients and PSF/gain values remain unexamined.

Run5566/rerun40/camcol3/field11 is a representative archive header, not an assignment to CID6057 or its first g MJD53616.457598. C_OBS and dimensions do not establish event exposure; the complete checked primary header has no EXPTIME.

Original5.04-labelled reduced lightcurve, DR7photo v5_4_28/export v6_0, pinned c447 SMPv8+BOSS release and current photoField/frame documentation are distinct reduction/product histories. Their flux, error, unit, clock and extraction operators are not established equivalent.

Legacy J2000 source RA52.553547/DEC−0.974675 differs from inherited later HEAD RA52.553604/DECL−0.974586. Blank later TUNIT values and absent EXPTIME remain unresolved; physical-event deduplication, frame/epoch and clock-scale joins are incomplete.

Legacy schema labels gain electrons/DN and dark_variance unitless; current photoField labels gain '(electrons)' and leaves dark_variance unlabeled. Literal schema units are preserved. Dimensional conditions of the frame error formula do not repair these labels into measured values or a detector law.

Current frame conditional error recipe needs matched calibration, sky, gain/dark values and masks; PCALIB/PSKY provenance and FLOATCOMPRESS lost precision matter. Provider Poisson/no-sky-error statements do not certify the actual measurement distribution, exact raw reconstruction or full covariance.

Run-level QA reports field holes despite 'no warnings'. Field quality, PSF status and culled masks do not determine transient detection/selection probability, missing-epoch censoring or complete selection support.

Run-list fields11–622, the reported612 calibration-directory names0011–0622 and QA nFields613 are distinct product views. Count reconciliation and full exposure completeness remain unexamined; NFIELDS1 describes only the selected tsField product.

Raw pixels, matched calibration/PSF/mask/reference bodies, readout/QE/extraction law, temporal/spatial/calibration and cross-probe covariance remain unknown. No Gaussian, independent-noise or joint-likelihood assumption is accepted.
